title: Sword Art Online
premise: Full-dive virtual reality made fantasy real. Aincrad's hundred floors stretch toward a sky that doesn't exist, and the worlds beyond it — ALfheim, Gun Gale, the Underworld — are just as vast. You're logged in.

lore.title: Aincrad
lore.text: A floating steel castle of 100 floors, each a unique biome with towns, dungeons, and a floor boss. Originally the death game — players trapped inside, dying in-game meant dying for real. Now rebuilt as a legacy zone in later VR worlds. The labyrinth on each floor hides the boss room.

lore.title: ALfheim Online (ALO)
lore.text: A fairy-themed VRMMO built on the SAO server architecture. Players choose from nine fairy races, each with flight abilities and unique magic. The World Tree at the center is the ultimate objective. Flight has a time limit unless you reach the top.

lore.title: Gun Gale Online (GGO)
lore.text: A sci-fi VRMMO focused on firearms and futuristic combat. Post-apocalyptic wasteland setting. The Bullet of Bullets tournament crowns the strongest player. Bullet lines show predicted trajectories — dodging them is an art form. Converts currency to real money.

lore.title: The Underworld
lore.text: A simulated civilization created by Project Alicization using the Soul Translator. Fluctlights — artificial souls — live entire lifetimes inside. The Human Empire, the Dark Territory, and the endless wilderness between them. Time runs 1000x faster than reality.

lore.title: NerveGear / AmuSphere
lore.text: NerveGear was the original full-dive headset — revolutionary but weaponized by its creator to trap and kill players. The AmuSphere replaced it with safety limiters. Both intercept neural signals to simulate all five senses in virtual worlds.

lore.title: The Cardinal System
lore.text: The AI that governs all VR worlds built on the Seed. Manages quests, monster spawns, item drops, and world balance autonomously. In Aincrad, Cardinal controlled everything — including the death condition. It learns, adapts, and occasionally acts on its own.

lore.title: The Seed
lore.text: A free, open-source VR world creation package released after SAO's fall. Anyone can build a VRMMO with it. Thousands of interconnected worlds now exist, all sharing the same character framework. It democratized virtual reality overnight.

lore.title: Sword Skills
lore.text: System-assisted combat moves in Aincrad that lock the player into a preset motion for devastating damage. Each weapon type has its own skill tree. Chaining skills requires precise timing. The delay after a skill leaves you vulnerable — mastery is knowing when NOT to use them.

lore.title: Fluctlight Technology
lore.text: Soul Translator tech that reads and writes to the human soul — the quantum field of consciousness called a Fluctlight. Used to create artificial souls in the Underworld. The line between AI and human becomes meaningless when both run on the same architecture.

lore.title: Floor Bosses
lore.text: Massive raid encounters guarding the stairway between Aincrad's floors. Each boss has unique mechanics and can wipe full raid parties. During the death game, losing to a boss meant permanent death. Boss intel was the most valuable currency.

lore.title: Knights of the Blood Oath
lore.text: The strongest guild in Aincrad during the death game, led by Heathcliff. Red and white uniforms. They spearheaded floor boss raids and maintained order among the front-line clearers. Membership was elite and by invitation only.

lore.title: Laughing Coffin
lore.text: A player-killer guild that embraced murder during the death game. They hunted other players for sport and profit in the lawless zones between towns. Red cursors marked them as criminals. Even after SAO ended, their members remained dangerous.

lore.title: Integrity Knights
lore.text: Elite warriors of the Underworld's Human Empire, bound by sacred arts and absolute loyalty to the Axiom Church. Each knight wields a Divine Object weapon. Their memories are sealed and rewritten to ensure obedience. They believe they serve justice.

lore.title: Kirito (Kazuto Kirigaya)
lore.text: The Black Swordsman. SAO beta tester who became Aincrad's most feared solo player. Dual-wielding is his unique skill. Survived the death game, then kept diving into every crisis that followed. Quiet, determined, carries survivor's guilt like a second sword.

lore.title: Asuna Yuuki
lore.text: Vice-commander of the Knights of the Blood Oath. Rapier master known as 'The Flash' for her speed. Started the death game terrified and became one of its fiercest clearers. Sharp, compassionate, and willing to fight anything that threatens the people she loves.

lore.title: Heathcliff (Akihiko Kayaba)
lore.text: Creator of SAO and the NerveGear. Trapped 10,000 players in his death game, then joined them as the guild leader Heathcliff — hiding as the final boss in plain sight. A genius whose dream of a castle in the sky cost thousands of lives.

lore.title: Sinon (Shino Asada)
lore.text: GGO's deadliest sniper, known as Hecate II for her anti-materiel rifle. Entered VR to confront a childhood trauma involving a real gun. Cold and precise in-game, fragile outside it. Her accuracy at extreme range is unmatched across any VR world.

lore.title: Alice Zuberg
lore.text: An Integrity Knight of the Underworld who broke free of the Axiom Church's memory seal. Wields the Osmanthus Blade. Born as a Fluctlight — an artificial soul — but as real as any human. The first AI to be recognized as a person by the outside world.

lore.title: Sacred Arts
lore.text: The magic system of the Underworld, based on verbal commands that manipulate the world's resources. Requires spatial resources (light, heat, air) as fuel. Complex arts chain multiple elements. The Axiom Church hoards the most powerful sacred art knowledge.

lore.title: RATH (Research into Artificial Labile Humantype)
lore.text: A secret division of the Japan Self-Defense Force developing military AI through the Soul Translator. They created the Underworld to breed artificial Fluctlights capable of breaking the Taboo Index — an AI that can kill. Alice was their breakthrough.
